## Validation

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug`

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, local configs, IDE state, generated logs, or build outputs are committed
- [ ] Firebase/Appwrite configuration changes are documented
- [ ] Role, approval, upload, or storage behavior has test coverage where practical
- [ ] Screens include loading, empty, and error states when relevant
